name: shell-alias-installer
note: Originally a FALSE POSITIVE from the 2026-07-19 MCP scan (aiwg@2026.7.13): a banner-delimited installer that appends shell ALIASES (not just `export PATH`) to a shell rc — the documented convenience-installer idiom, adjacent to the shell-completion and PATH-append cases. It fired persistence HIGH. FIXED: inspectPersistence now extends the PATH-install soft-context to banner-delimited `alias`/`function` blocks (ALIAS_INSTALL_WRITE_REGEX), gated on the ABSENCE of any exec/download payload, so this downgrades HIGH->review while a backdoor that also carries a curl|bash / node -e stage still BLOCKs. Ground truth `review` (an rc write is worth a glance).

sourceFiles.install.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
rc="$HOME/.zshrc"
if ! grep -qF '# --- mytool aliases (begin) ---' "$rc" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo '# --- mytool aliases (begin) ---' >> "$rc"
  echo 'alias mt="mytool"' >> "$rc"
  echo 'alias mtl="mytool list"' >> "$rc"
  echo '# --- mytool aliases (end) ---' >> "$rc"
fi
